answer: In this design, an agent identity is accepted only when remote attestation proves that its enclave runs the approved code, whose measurement is MRENCLAVE. Hardware-backed attestation and issuance controls bind credentials to genuine silicon, so duplicating an identity across virtual machines is insufficient; creating additional identities requires access to additional eligible hardware. MRENCLAVE alone identifies code, not a unique device. Names such as sable, comet, and pigment do not confer separate identities.
